continue_button.label: Continuar a la siguiente actividad
continue_button.handler_expected_effect: handleContinue builds the submit payload and calls onContinue; in /dev/e2e-block0 handleSignificadoContinue should advance to the next selected primary activity but currently only sets a submit notice.

activity_state.activity_state_variable: currentActivity derived from effectivePrimaryActivitySelectionResult.selectedPrimaryActivities[0]; no mutable current activity cursor found for Significado continuation
activity_state.current_activity_derivation: SignificadoDeTuTrabajo computes currentActivity from selectedPrimaryActivities[0]. buildE2eBlock0DemoTrace also reports primaryActivitySelectionResult.selectedPrimaryActivities[0].
activity_state.next_activity_derivation: Not implemented in the observed handler; no state update selects selectedPrimaryActivities[1] after Continue.

gate_rules.transition_allowed_rule: handleContinue proceeds when isWorkMapSaved, isBlock0ReviewComplete and buildDraftSubmitPayload returns a payload; then calls onContinue.

causal_diagnosis.probable_cause_summary: The Continue button is enabled and wired through SignificadoDeTuTrabajo.handleContinue to onContinue, but /dev/e2e-block0 handleSignificadoContinue only sets a demo completion notice and does not update an activity cursor. The displayed currentActivity is always derived from selectedPrimaryActivities[0], so the UI remains on Actividad 1 de 8.
causal_diagnosis.recommended_fix_scope: Implement a local/demo current activity cursor or equivalent selected activity state, advance it in handleSignificadoContinue when another selected primary activity exists, and pass the active activity to SignificadoDeTuTrabajo without connecting DB/Supabase.
